mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes simvastatin, increasing simvastatin plasma concentrations and myopathy risk; additionally, both drugs may increase bleeding risk through effects on platelet aggregation and coagulation.
action: Monitor for signs of myopathy (muscle pain, weakness, dark urine); consider alternative statin or dose reduction of simvastatin; monitor coagulation parameters and bleeding signs.
